reviews.title: Bad update: A focus app shouldn’t become a distraction
reviews.text:
I’m a Forest fan, but the latest update has made the app frustrating to use. After each focus session, I have to tap through too many confirmations and reward screens just to collect coins and move on. The extra steps and animations add friction to something that used to feel simple.

A productivity app should respect our time and attention. I use Forest to stay focused, and these unnecessary interactions have become another distraction.

Please make rewards automatic and fast. A 0.1s quick button tap and then it should be done.  Bring back the simple, efficient experience that made Forest so enjoyable.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with the changes made to the app. I really miss the old designs of the trees and plants in particular! The classic tree and the simple visual changes for increases in time were so much better than the new design. Not everything needs to be upgraded or changed. If something isn’t broken, don’t fix it. What was wrong with the old design? 

Also why am I being marketed Plus if I already have Pro? It feels like the app I used to love was killed and now it’s an evil zombie back from the dead trying to extract money from me, pretending to be an old friend. Part of the reason I supported this app in the first place was because it allowed for a one time payment rather than a subscription model. Now I feel like the rug has been pulled out from under me. I don’t even have access to what I thought I paid for because the app interface, look, and feel has changed so much. 

I already paid for this app and now they’re taking features away and gate keeping them with a subscription. I see the replies in the comments acting like pro is still valid but, cmon bro, you know what you did. You cheapened it to try to get more money from me. Shameless.

reviews.title: New Update Very Frustrating
reviews.text:
I’ve used and enjoyed this app for years, but this new update made sometime in September or October of 2026 has significantly reduced my satisfaction and compelled me to write this review. 

In some apparent effort to make the app something more profitable or inspiring more engagement, they have added all sorts of “events” and continued to focus on the coin shop. Worst of all, though, is they changed the UI so now I have to tap roughly 4 times to exit a timer I just set, when it used to be once. The app also no longer displays my total focus time for the day without having to tap 3-4 times to go see it on a separate screen. Why? They’ve also made many overtures to get me to “relax” as if this is a meditation app or something.

I bought this years ago just to time my focus and track my progress, as well as have a motivator in the form of the tree. Please just keep this simple or give me the option to strip away the excessive features that don’t serve that purpose and make this app more convoluted. I will have to move to a different method in the future, otherwise, and that saddens me since I’ve used this for 5+ years without issue until now.

reviews.title: Love Forest, but the new UI broke the repeat flow

After the recent major UI update, finishing a tree has become frustrating: I now have to tap through multiple steps just to claim the coins. Worse, the old flow let me quickly repeat/restart a new tree with the same duration from the lock screen after finishing one. That no longer works, because I have to unlock my phone, open the app, claim the reward through several taps, and only then start again. This breaks the quick focus loop that made Forest so effective. Please bring back one-tap repeat from the lock screen and make claiming rewards much faster.

reviews.title: New UI Has Some Pros, But I Haaaaate the Popups
reviews.text:
They changed the user interface today. 

What I like:
- The new “my plants” section makes it easier to see trees.
- It’s easier to pick a tag.

What I don’t like:
- Annoying popups flash across my screen when I finish planting a tree and want to back to the home screen! This app is supposed to reduce distractions, not create them. 
- Some of the trees displayed are not purchasable in the store, yet clicking on them still takes me to the store. 
- There are still very few tag colors. Other people and I specifically submitted a feedback request asking for more tag colors, but there are still just a handful. 

What I feel mixed about:
- The trees bounce up and down, and the coin icon shimmers. It’s kind of cool, but also very distracting.



Edit; I changed my review to one star. They’re now deleting trees from the regular store and making you rebuy them for a much higher price only on certain days when they happen to appear in the temporary store that refreshes daily. This is so stupid. It’s clear that they’re creating a scarcity mindset to pressure people to check the app often. That goes against the whole point of making an app to get you off your phone!

reviews.title: disappointed
reviews.text:
I have had forest since it launched and want to start by saying I appreciate the app, the team, and their desire to improve the app and experience. 

That said, I am very disappointed and sad about the new update. 

I use forest 5-10 times per day to track different tasks and timeline my day/focus and the loss of the “favorite” option has been extremely frustrating. I DO NOT want to select a tree snd scroll through all of my 20+ tags every single time. I really appreciated the fact I could save 10+ trees/tags for quick use. Please please bring this back. 

I will again say I appreciate the team for trying to improve and build on the app but feel the updates have taken us far off course of the goal and purpose of the app. I just want to pop in, set my focus and FOCUS ON MY TASK, not spend time scrolling a million different trees and challenges etc. They have added so many distractions and lost sight of the “put your phone down and focus” mantra

reviews.title: New Update is Awful
reviews.text: I have been using this app for NINE YEARS. I love it, and it’s always been my favorite focus app. However, the newly-updated UI is unbelievably terrible. It looks messy, it’s distracting (the opposite of what this app is supposed to be!), and it is hard to use. It used to be so easy to quickly plant a tree and set the timer. Now, it takes at least double the amount of clicks, and it’s so difficult to set the timer to exactly what you need. They even took away custom phrases (apparently those will be coming back, but even still… what the heck!). I absolutely hate it, and I wish the developers would listen to their users and allow us to opt back into the old interface. I don’t think I’ll be using Forest unless I can get back to a more simple and user-friendly UI.

reviews.title: Used to be excellent, worrying trends in updates

Then in their most recent update they overhauled the UI, including the removal of sorting by favorites. They did include tree names now which was a plus, but it was 1 step forward and 2 steps back. The addition of an additional paid tier followed by a major hit to usability is a worrying trend that has ended in many other apps becoming freemium or ad filled, unusable shells of themselves - Forest isn’t there yet but I’ve seen this movie before.

reviews.title: Downhill Slide
reviews.text: I’ve used this app since 2016 and have been a huge advocate for it since early days. While I can’t think of any period of time in the past decade where the Forest app has maintained excellent stability free of glitches, the overall usefulness of the app has allowed me to look past that. In the past 12-18 months, things have been going downhill. The devs keep pushing out excessive updates that prioritize gamification in the app and focus on money-making capacity of the app. All the while, stability in the app for users like myself and my friends has decreased and glitches have increased to the point of a non-functional app. Sharing session links, planting together, and Deep Focus mode are all useless now with the rollout of a new UI and the retirement of “classic” mode. It’s a real shame. I’ve accumulated over 275 days of planting time in this app, the majority of which were logged in Plant Together mode with friends. I’ll be sad to leave the app and my land of virtual trees behind, but it may be the natural course of things if the devs continue to ignore prioritization of the function and stability of the Forest app.

reviews.title: Update missing basic features

You associate one tree per tag and then look at your Forest and see how many of each you have for the day, week, etc.  they used to allow you to switch to classic mode, but they removed that in the most recent update.  If they don’t bring that back in the next month or so, I’ll probably stop using it.

reviews.title: Terrible update
reviews.text:
I have been a power user of the forest app for over a decade and this newest update is absolutely horrendous. It is so much less intuitive in terms of changing the timeframe and toggling between plant together/solo modes. 

I also just generally have noticed so much more buggy behavior when trying to use “plant together” mode, which is one of the main features of the app that I use on a day to day basis. I love being able to do a focus session remotely with another person, and that is my main use-case for this app. But lately people are getting kicked out of trees, unable to join trees, etc. Instead of adding all these new features and bells and whistles, Forest should focus on making their core functionality bug-free. 

I have been using this app for a long time but if the bugginess continues to be an issue I will have to look for a new focus app.

reviews.title: I love this app, but…
reviews.text:
I really love this app. I’ve been using it for years and have found it very helpful to focus and track my writing time. However, since the introduction of focus challenge I have been annoyed by the implementation. My biggest issue is the fact that I have to reset my focus timer each time I want to “plant a tree” for the challenge. If I do 2 hours in the app, it says I planted 4 trees in my forest but only one tree for the daily challenge. If the daily challenge says “plant any tree 4 times” I have to start and stop my focus timer four times (once every 30 minutes) in order for the trees to count. Why? The fact that I have to interrupt my focus time to stop and reset in order to achieve the daily challenge is ridiculous. It’s actually the opposite of focus, enough that I may have to switch to a different app because it is distracting me trying to keep my trees and focus time to match. 

Please fix this. Make it so that when I focus for a number of hours, the daily challenge counts my trees planted, not by the number of times I started focusing. It feels like a bug, but it’s been present since the focus challenge released. Thanks!

reviews.title: New interface and design is awful
reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with this update. I bought this app before everything became subscription based, and now after this update I had to log back in and basically create a new account. I don’t even know if my original purchase matters anymore or what I actually still have access to.

The new interface is awful and whoever had the idea to change it should be fired. The old app was so much clearer, more fun, and actually made studying feel exciting. I even looked forward to studying because of the app and it didn’t feel like every other boring, repetitive dull study app. It was easy to navigate, aesthetically pleasing to the eye and everything just felt more organized.

Now the entire interface is so bland, boring, and mundane. It honestly feels like they took away everything that made the app enjoyable in the first place. I understand apps need updates, but completely changing the design/ display AND moving everything toward a subscription model feels like such a downgrade, especially for people who already paid for the app before.

I hope they would bring back the old interface, or at least give us the option to switch back to the old version. And I definitely think they need to be clearer about what happens to people who already purchased the app before the subscription change because that’s just theft

reviews.title: New Update ruined everything
reviews.text: I have had forest for about 7 years now and have reliably used it throughout high school and college. I LOVED it. So simple and easy to use, kept me motivated. I started grad school this week and when I logged in, I was booted from my account, and random data was lost. The entire past three years, special trees I bought for specific tasks, and random entries throughout are all gone. Not to mention, there are a million pop ups on start up, and the new design is pretty, but the beauty of this app was simplicity. I could actually focus on what I needed and keep track of my progress. Now that is gone, it’s become so tacky, and I am considering walking away permanently, which really stinks. They had a good thing going for some time. Too bad it’s ending this way. :/
